text: Public ultimatum is issued alongside continued denial of direct negotiations by counterparties. Mediated message exchange is acknowledged without formal talks. Military positioning expands while regional actors issue coordinated statements. No confirmed negotiation channel is established.

meta.note: Coexistence of mediation and denial creates layered communication structure without unified channel definition.

text: Meta equity declines following consecutive adverse court rulings. Liability findings across jurisdictions remain active with appeals pending. Capital expenditure commitments and layoffs occur concurrently. Multiple pending cases maintain active legal pressure on platform design and operations.

meta.note: Financial impact remains limited relative to scale while legal signal density increases.

text: Pause on attacks against energy infrastructure is extended to April 6. Strait of Hormuz remains largely closed with limited tanker passage. Conflicting statements on existence of talks continue. Equity markets decline while oil prices rise under sustained constraint.

meta.note: Extended pause with unchanged flow restriction maintains constraint without resolution.
